triage.root_cause: calc.py:average divides sum(values) by len(values) with no empty-input guard, so an empty list raises ZeroDivisionError instead of the required 0.0.
triage.rationale: SPEC.md requires calc.average to return 0.0 for an empty list, and the report shows ZeroDivisionError instead. The cause is localized to calc.py:average and nothing is unactionable.

steps: Create sandbox/demo-app/test_calc_empty.py with a test that asserts calc.average([]) == 0.0.
In sandbox/demo-app/calc.py, add an empty-input guard to average() so that it returns 0.0 when values is empty.
Leave the non-empty path unchanged: the arithmetic mean, sum(values) / len(values).

implement.summary: Added an empty-input guard to average() returning 0.0, leaving the sum(values)/len(values) path unchanged.
